name: p-shed
description: Scheduler/launcher for Claude Code headless runs. Cron-scheduled jobs launch `claude -p` in a folder, with per-job model, timeout, duplicate guard, missed-tick catch-up, log rotation, a process-level circuit breaker, and a task-level self-pause marker. Pure scheduler — no task storage. Commands (tool `pshed`): tick, run, install-cron, remove-cron, set-job, rm-job, reset-breaker. Skills: init, start, stop, job, reset-breaker.
